name: maxgfr-skills
description: maxgfr's process skills for agent-driven engineering — installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: maxgfr
plugins.description: One manual loop, three explicit-only skills: blueprint plans a change and gets it approved, build implements the approved plan step by step in a worktree, and verify proves the result. Either end can be crosschecked against the other CLI agent, and build can hand the coding to it. Skills land under the maxgfr: namespace.
